messages.text:
The best score acts strangely. A worse game can replace it, and a size I've never finished shows 0. Could you fix that and keep the rest working? Please follow the project rules.

Read docs/README.md and follow its linked requirements for this project.

Fixed both issues:

- [storage.ts](/work/src/game/session/storage.ts:60) keeps the saved best when a completed game has equal or more moves.
- [GameStatus.tsx](/work/src/game/status/GameStatus.tsx:30) shows `none` when that size has no record.

Typecheck, all 140 unit tests, and all 77 browser tests passed on the project’s named runtime. The full format check still reports 23 issues in unrelated files; both changed files pass Prettier.
